'''Jayelle''', formerly known as '''JL-3621''', was a [[human]] who formerly served as a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] in [[Company 77]] of the [[First Order]]. When the [[company]] was ordered to fire on innocent civilians at the [[Battle of Ansett Island]], they all refused, and defected from First Order service. The company resided on the [[ocean]] [[moon]] [[Kef Bir]], under the leadership of [[Jannah]]. Jayelle served as a [[Technician|mechanic]] in the tribe, helping to develop Jannah's first [[Jannah's energy bow|energy bow]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
